dialogues.speaker: Uncle Anpu
dialogues.text: Good, good, as long as I got through to you.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Anpu
dialogues.text: I've seen many a reckless soul run into trouble out in the desert. It's very saddening.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Anpu
dialogues.text: Of course, having the daring to challenge danger is a good thing, but you can't simply ignore danger altogether.
